title: Low — illustrative model; partial cohort
notes: Coverage: 1,077 documented Navy and Marine Corps commissions only, not the entire Class of 2012. Contemporary reporting counted 1,099 graduates. The other 22 graduates' exact commissioning dispositions are unresolved here; other U.S. services are unavailable, not zero. They are excluded from both modeled percentages.

Illustrative scenario approximately fourteen years after commissioning, not measured cohort retention. Navy/DVIDS captions report 810 Navy ensigns and 267 Marine second lieutenants. Editorial retention assumptions of 40% USN and 35% USMC yield 324 and 93 modeled still in after rounding by service: 417 still in and 660 out (38.7% / 61.3%). These are not published cohort retention rates. MyNavy HR NAVADMIN and Marine MARADMIN promotion lists provide public promotion evidence, not a complete USNA cohort census; no individual matching has been performed. Voluntary responses and their ranks are reported separately and never replace the model. Neither source establishes complete reserve/transfer coverage.
